_about: Monthly hazards for the vendor capabilities cogmer's capture and injection rely on. Every number is either derived from a counted history (see 'source') or marked 'assumed'. Rates are per capability per month, for a change that affects cogmer in ordinary use.

A_ids.source: Claude Code changelog 2025-07..2026-11: 2 bullets on wrong/nonexistent transcript_path (2.1.72, 2.1.141) among ~8 adverse changes to documented hook fields in 16 months over ~9 capabilities (0.055/cap-month), halved because both hit only resumed or worktree sessions. No hook field removed in 16 months; removal is the rule-of-three bound scaled down (assumed).

A_prompt.source: 2.1.299 (2026-10-14) moved UserPromptSubmit before command expansion; 2.1.328 stopped it on Code Mode output; Cowork cloud first prompt arrives empty (open.md, 2026-11-18). Same family rate as A_ids.

A_stop.source: last_assistant_message added 2.1.47 (2026-02-18), documented as the way to read the final text; Stop-related fixes 2.1.136 (loud: plugin Stop hooks failing after cache cleanup), 2.1.331. Family rate.

A_stoppid.source: assumed: prompt_id on Stop is less prominent in the hooks reference than session_id, so set 1.5x the family rate.

A_transcript.source: Undocumented; the hooks reference says the file 'is written asynchronously and may lag'. cogmer saw one transcript-timing change (B05, 2.1.331, 2026-11-24) in ~70 releases over 2.4 months and no failure of B06-B17; 174 'Fixed' transcript bullets in 16 months are mostly resume bugs. 0.05 is a judgment between those (assumed, varied 0.02-0.15).

A_inject.source: 2.1.292 escaped system-reminder tags in hook output; 2.1.296 fixed hook output altered by hint-tag text (both change the text the model gets). Documented for UserPromptSubmit and SessionStart. Family rate.

A_evidence.source: Undocumented attachment record; Cowork records the JSON form as hook_additional_context rather than hook_success (D-206, 5ac6450), i.e. two record kinds already exist. assumed 2x family rate.

A_cap.source: 2.1.89 (2026-03-31) began saving output over 10,000 characters to a file with a 2,000-character preview; cogmer users saw it 2026-10-14 (1df545d). 2.1.290 and 2.1.321 changed long-output handling again. 3 changes in 16 months = 0.19/month family, but only the first crossed cogmer's budget: 1 in 16 months ~ 0.06; set lower because cogmer now keeps a 1,000-character margin (assumed).

A_mcphook.source: type mcp_tool added 2.1.118 (2026-04-22); changed or fixed in 2.1.281, 2.1.284, 2.1.321, 2.1.323, 2.1.325, 2.1.328: 6 in 7 months, about half touching what cogmer uses = 0.4/month raw over a handful of behaviors; 0.06 per capability.

A_msgdisp.b: new: MessageDisplay fires per assistant text message with session_id
A_msgdisp.source: added 2.1.152 (2026-05-26) as a display transform; display-path hooks change with the UI. assumed 2x family rate, removal 5x.

A_otel.b: new: OTel user_prompt and assistant_response log events
A_otel.source: assistant_response added 2.1.193 (2026-06-25); 2.1.323 fixed user_prompt events recording a background agent's reply; 2.1.332 'Breaking' service.name change and redaction change. 3 in 5 months.

A_cloudenv.b: D-288 D-290 D-297 (plugin loads, hooks fire, daemon reaches relay in a cloud container)
A_cloudenv.source: cogmer's own record 2026-10-18..11-25: defaultEnabled false silences hooks (9477067), relay needs WebSocket behind the proxy (e415f1d), marketplace copy stale for a month (db8eced), empty transcript_path (D-295), empty first prompt: ~5 surface findings in ~1.5 months of probing; most were found once, not recurring, so 0.08/month (assumed).

O_ids.source: Codex release notes (stable releases 0.123-0.172, 2026-04-23..2026-11-24): hooks marked stable 0.124; 0.131 'use new session IDs instead of thread IDs for hooks'; 0.149 'Run hooks with the captured session environment'; 0.154 HookMetadata shape change. ~5 adverse in 7 months over ~5 capabilities, weighted 0.5.

O_inject.source: 0.129 'Spill large hook outputs from context'; 0.131 spill PreToolUse additionalContext; 0.145 configurable spill limits; default limit ~2,500 tokens (learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks, read 2026-11-28). cogmer sets additionalContextLimit 0.

O_stop.source: documented 'Latest assistant message text, if available' (learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks). assumed slightly below O_ids.

O_rollout.source: OpenAI says the 'transcript format isn't a stable interface for hooks and may change' (learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks). Release notes: compressed cold rollouts 0.137 (2026-06-04), compressed active rollouts 0.142, threads without local rollout paths 0.130, paginated history and legacy migration 0.147-0.148 (2026-08), obsolete turn-context fields removed 0.162: ~5 in 7 months (0.7/month raw); B26/B27 still passed in Oct-Nov, so most did not touch what cogmer reads: 0.10. Counter-signal: PR #28632 'Tell codex to avoid changing rollout format' (0.142).

O_cloudhooks.b: new: command hooks run in Codex cloud / Work Cloud
O_cloudhooks.source: learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks (2026-11-28): 'Cloud orchestration supports only Global MCP hooks'; open.md: whether a Codex cloud task loads the plugin's hooks is unknown. Treated as absent at month 0, arriving by improvement.

shock.source: OpenAI ended ChatGPT plugins with 3 weeks' notice (new installs stopped 2024-03-19, conversations 2024-04-09) and sunset the Assistants API on 2026-08-26 a year after announcing it; Codex moved hooks to stable and plugin-bundled hooks in 2026-04/05. Two extension-surface replacements in ~36 months = 0.055/month, halved for the chance that one touches Codex hooks: 0.03. Anthropic has removed no extension surface since hooks shipped (2025-06); 'mod' hooks (prompt.submit) appear beside hooks in 2.1.296 (2026-10-09), so 0.015 (assumed).

improve.source: Claude Code added a relevant capability about every 2 months (last_assistant_message 2.1.47, http hooks 2.1.63, mcp_tool 2.1.118, MessageDisplay 2.1.152, assistant_response 2.1.193, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID in Bash 2.1.132); 0.04 for one specific missing capability is assumed.

vendor_fix.source: 2.1.296 regression fixed in 2.1.299 five days later; intentional changes (2.1.89 output cap) never reverted. Share assumed.

detect.source: doctor runs when a room is formed under an unchecked version (D-129); Claude Code ships ~27 releases a month, so a new version meets a room within days to weeks (assumed 0.3 month). B34's silent failure was reported by users two days after its symptoms began (1df545d) but had existed since 2.1.89, six months earlier, before cogmer existed; 1.5 months is assumed for silence in general and varied 0.5-4.

adapt.source: cogmer released 0.10.x to 0.11.x within weeks of findings (git log); the account's marketplace copy for Cowork cloud stayed at v0.10.4 for a month with sync on (D-290 Limits, db8eced).
